digest.component_or_area: Rebar reconciler mutation tests / DC backend adapters
propositions: DC convergence test suites for comment and description length are missing, whereas Cloud has two incident-hardened suites that verify oversized text converges across two reconciliation passes
DC's sanitize_comment incorrectly reuses fit_outbound (the description fitter) rather than routing through a dedicated comment-fit path, and the binding lacks provenance documentation

_diff_comments does not accept or forward a sanitizer parameter, causing a DC comment convergence test to silently fall back to Cloud's sanitizer via select_backend(load_config()), yielding false-green results

compute_outbound_mutations guards against incomplete backend injection via OR (fires fallback if any of outbound_mapper, inbound_mapper, or links is None), so partial injection still silently resolves to Cloud

DC's comment ceiling of 32767 is the documented default of jira.text.field.character.limit and is configurable per-instance, but rebar hardcodes it and does not query the live value, risking data loss on reconfigured instances
